taxonomy.rim_cap: top of a convex turn / crest where the contour reverses vertical direction (e.g. ⌒, ＿ over ／ ＼)
taxonomy.shoulder: transition from a cap/crest into a steep flank (e.g. ／￣, ￣＼)
taxonomy.flank: steep near-vertical run of a rounded form below or above a shoulder
taxonomy.side: straight side of a non-rounded form (box/wall/pole edge)
taxonomy.return_base: lower turn that closes a form back toward the other side (e.g. ＼＿／, ヽ_ノ)
taxonomy.closed_ring: small closed contour, e.g. an eye or pupil ring
taxonomy.paired_aperture: two matched small openings, e.g. nostrils
taxonomy.upper_tooth_row: upper row of teeth / periodic serrated edge seen from below
taxonomy.lower_tooth_row: lower row of teeth / periodic serrated edge seen from above
taxonomy.periodic_band: repeated glyph rhythm carrying a material band (fence, stitch, grille, pattern)
taxonomy.fold_crease: short interior stroke explaining a fold, crease or joint without closing it
taxonomy.contact_junction: where two forms meet/attach (branch entry, finger to palm, root to ground)
taxonomy.opening_paper_gap: deliberately empty paper that separates or opens forms
taxonomy.tone_core: densest part of a bounded tone field
taxonomy.tone_mid: thinning band of a tone field
taxonomy.tone_fringe: sparse outer dots/marks where tone dissolves into paper
taxonomy.cast_shadow_edge: edge of a cast shadow on a ground/surface

role_extensions.branch_entry: the few strokes where a branch leaves a trunk or goes up into the crown/leaf mass (fork, twig tip, underside entry)
role_extensions.night_speckle: isolated star/speck accents (☆ 。 ﾟ) spaced across blank night sky, distinct from tone and from a sunset gradient
role_extensions.grass_patch: patchy grass: short runs of grass marks separated by deliberate empty intervals, so the field reads as clumps rather than a uniform band
role_extensions.falling_accent: isolated falling leaf/fruit/petal marks, each surrounded by paper, placed near or under the crown they fell from
role_extensions.underside_view: the lower edge of a crown/branch seen from below: hanging scallops or kana hooks that close the leaf mass over the trunk or branch
role_extensions.whole_circle: a complete drawn round (cap, sides and return together) recorded as one construction, distinct from closed_ring, which is kept for eye/pupil rings
role_extensions.texture_boundary: edge of a form carried only by where a texture/punctuation field stops against paper, with no traced outline (structural-line-selection.md 'Texture-supported boundary')
